from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions
from .models import CommercialInvoice
from .serializers import CommercialInvoiceSerializer
from .permissions import IsInvoiceTenantMember

class CommercialInvoiceViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = CommercialInvoice.objects.all()
    serializer_class = CommercialInvoiceSerializer

    def get_permissions(self):
        if self.action in ['retrieve', 'update', 'partial_update']:
            return [IsInvoiceTenantMember()]
        # Faulty: 'destroy' is permitted for any authenticated user
        return [permissions.IsAuthenticated()]
diagnosis: CommercialInvoiceViewSet protects 'retrieve', 'update', and 'partial_update' actions using IsInvoiceTenantMember, but leaves the default return statement returning [permissions.IsAuthenticated()]. As a result, DELETE requests invoke destroy() using the un-scoped queryset CommercialInvoice.objects.all(). Any authenticated user can delete commercial invoices belonging to competitor organizations.
